requirements.title: A structure constructor has a type specifier and a separate component list

requirements.definition: A structure-constructor is derived-type-spec followed by parentheses enclosing an optional component-spec-list. Even an empty component list retains those parentheses. For a PDT the type-parameter parentheses belong to derived-type-spec and precede the separate component-list parentheses. Empty syntax does not waive C7104 or accessibility, and a bare-type-name form that resolves as a same-named generic function has C7108's interpretation instead.
